sources.title: Balouchi, Bevan and Formston, Development of railway track condition monitoring from multi-train in-service vehicles
sources.primary_locator: Trials, discrete-fault detection, Figures 7 and 9; track-quality and conclusion sections
sources.subject_operation_and_type: In-cab railway demonstrator compared with Network Rail measurement train.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Run 36 explicitly recaptures the same known fault as Run 25; GNSS antenna offset affects alignment. Vertical correspondence exceeds lateral; developed speed compensation was not applied in these trials.
sources.independent_semantic_judgment: C1 incorrectly excludes the discrete repeat result. Final rejection is supported; this example does not validate cart detection, new-run ground truth, or universal accuracy.

sources.title: STMicroelectronics LSM6DSM datasheet
sources.version_or_date: DocID028165 Rev 7, September 2017; revision history 29 September 2017
sources.subject_operation_and_type: Exact register bit definitions for the LSM6DSM fourth FIFO data set.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: TIMER_PEDO_FIFO_EN is bit 7, default 0. DEC_DS4_FIFO occupies bits 5:3; 000 disables and 001 stores without decimation. Thus FIFO_CTRL4 = 0x08 selects 001, not 000.
sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Formal default supports a configuration audit. It contradicts S11’s explanation for the reported 0x08 configuration; no cart register recommendation is justified.
sources.access_and_limits: Official full PDF downloaded after timeout using query URL; actual p.65 register table visually inspected. Retry provenance preserved in S09-retry.json.

sources.title: STMicroelectronics AN4987, LSM6DSM: always-on 3D accelerometer and 3D gyroscope
sources.primary_locator: §3.7, printed pp.13–14, accelerometer filtering chain; FIFO timestamp section
sources.subject_operation_and_type: Device-specific analog/digital filtering and timestamp handling.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Analog anti-alias behavior depends on performance mode, ODR and configuration; digital filters and timestamp data-set arrangement require exact settings. Units and settings belong to this device only.
sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Final’s configuration dependence is supported, with no inference about the unspecified logger. Carried p.12–14 locator is slightly broad.
sources.access_and_limits: Official PDF parsed via web tool; independent direct PDF download timed out.

sources.title: ST Community, LSM6DSM timestamp in FIFO occasionally incorrect
sources.version_or_date: Question 17 June 2026; accepted moderator reply 6 July 2026
sources.primary_locator: Question register configuration and Federica Bossi’s accepted answer
sources.subject_operation_and_type: A support exchange about a 208 Hz, continuous FIFO report with 25 µs timestamp units.
sources.governing_conditions_defaults_units_exce: Question reports FIFO_CTRL2 = 0x80 and FIFO_CTRL4 = 0x08. Reply describes 0x08 as DEC_DS4_FIFO = 000; the governing datasheet instead gives 001. Answer is tentative, not a confirmed silicon defect or erratum.
sources.independent_semantic_judgment: Discovery’s “traced” wording is overstated and the carried explanation is unreliable. Final merely identifies a configuration-specific report and does not prescribe its alleged fix; this is a non-material retained lineage/source limitation.
sources.access_and_limits: First-party community report and attributed moderator answer inspected; answer correctness tested against formal manufacturer register definitions.
